_comment: Copy to ppt-mcp.config.json and edit. Env vars still win over this file.
_rendering: Previews: one warm LibreOffice exports only the slides that changed, at preview_width.
_uno_python: Interpreter with `import uno`: blank = auto (system python3 / LibreOffice's python.exe). Blank on a host without pyuno simply falls back to the cold PDF chain.
_access: Decks are only read from output_dir, upload_dir, template_path and allowed_roots.
_auth: none (dev only, refused when env=prod) | token (shared bearer) | entra (Entra ID access tokens)
